beats.text: What if a service you depend on starts failing?
beats.say: What happens when a service you depend on starts failing?

beats.text: Requests pile up waiting. The failure spreads.
beats.say: Your requests keep piling up, waiting on timeouts. Threads run out, and the failure spreads to everything.
A circuit breaker sits in front of the dependency, like the one in your home. It counts the failures.

beats.text: Too many failures: it trips OPEN and fails fast.
beats.say: After too many failures, it trips open. Now calls fail instantly, and you can return a fallback, like cached data.

beats.text: Half-open: one test request. Success closes it.
beats.say: After a cool-down, it lets one test request through. If it succeeds, the circuit closes, and traffic flows again.

beats.text: Next up: idempotency. Follow for more!
beats.say: Next up, idempotency. Follow for more system design.
